sections.name: Duets by Gemini Select
sections.description: Premium two-ply engraving plastic. Top layer engraves to reveal contrasting color beneath.

products.name: 24" x 49" x 1/16" Matte Black/White Gemini Duets Selects
products.description: Gemini Duets Selects are a single-pass laser or rotary engravable impact   modified acrylic that can be used both indoors and outdoors. The non-glare matte and satin/brush finishes are UV stable. Duets Selects are great for  interior or exterior signage, personal identification, industrial labeling,safety signage, and trophies and awards.
